# PUDL

> PUDL 2026.9.1.dev39 documentation


2016-2026, Catalyst Cooperative, CC-BY-4.0

## Pages in this subsection

- [pudl.dagster.assets](index.html.md): Dagster asset loading and grouping for PUDL.
- [pudl.dagster.assets.core](core/index.html.md): Core Dagster asset-definition modules for PUDL.
- [pudl.dagster.assets.core.datapackage](core/datapackage/index.html.md): Dagster asset that generates the PUDL frictionless datapackage descriptor.
- [pudl.dagster.assets.core.eiaapi_electricity](core/eiaapi_electricity/index.html.md): Dagster assets for EIA API electricity aggregates.
- [pudl.dagster.assets.core.glue](core/glue/index.html.md): Dagster assets for cross-dataset glue tables.
- [pudl.dagster.assets.core.static](core/static/index.html.md): Dagster assets for static reference tables.
- [pudl.dagster.assets.deploy](deploy/index.html.md): Dagster assets dedicated to deploying data build products.
- [pudl.dagster.assets.deploy.ferceqr](deploy/ferceqr/index.html.md): Define deployment helper assets for publishing FERC EQR outputs.
- [pudl.dagster.assets.output](output/index.html.md): Output Dagster asset-definition modules for PUDL.
- [pudl.dagster.assets.output.databases](output/databases/index.html.md): Dagster assets that assemble pudl.sqlite and pudl.duckdb from the Parquet outputs.
- [pudl.dagster.assets.raw](raw/index.html.md): Raw Dagster asset-definition modules for PUDL.
- [pudl.dagster.assets.raw.ferc_to_sqlite](raw/ferc_to_sqlite/index.html.md): Dagster asset definitions for granular FERC-to-SQLite extraction.
